transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 308 Stoney Fork Drive?
Yes, this is 308 Stoney Fork Drive. I’m here with two people, no water inside, and I can help—emergency services can send a truck.
Thank you for your help and patience. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are two people here total, and neither of them can’t come to the phone.

Thank you for sharing that information with us. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I just corrected myself — there are two people, and neither uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound.
Thank you for clarifying that situation. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, there’s no water inside the home right now. I meant to say, there’s no water inside — just to be clear.
Thank you for confirming no water is inside your home. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I have a high-clearance truck available to help neighbors get out. I don’t have a boat or any free seats in a vehicle.
Thanks for offering your truck to help neighbors. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet; you can help with a truck. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — two people here, no water inside yet, and I can help with a truck.

Thanks for confirming and offering the truck. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
